Troubleshot all units which we determined were having air flow issues. The units had alarms for low SST and for high head pressure. After resetting the alarms and watching the unit run we thought that there must have been a point messed up in the controls. When the unit was calling for high cooling we would see it command the economizer to open wide and take in the 85 degree outside air with only the supply fan running. After many attempts of trying to solve the problem we saw that the outdoor air sensor was reading 0 degrees instead of not reading anything at all. The sensor is not installed as of yet but the unit was thinking that it could use 0 degree air to cool the building. We had the controls guy force the reading to 80 degrees so that it would no longer economize and after letting the unit run we determined that that was indeed our issue.
